description: This file defines the CompanyStructureDao class responsible for database operations related to company structure entities, specifically Subunit objects, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and hierarchical tree management.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for company structure, managing Subunit entities and their hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Fetches a Subunit entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a Subunit entity to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a child Subunit to a parent Subunit node and clears EntityManager cache.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a Subunit node from its hierarchy.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates the organization name for Subunit entities at level 0.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Retrieves the hierarchical tree of Subunits, optionally limited by depth.

methods.name: getMaxLevel
methods.description: Returns the maximum level value among Subunits.
